basic_info.description: Welcome to 435 Wilde Avenue, located in a family-friendly neighborhood. This is the perfect home for multigenerational living or the possibility of passive income with a downstairs bonus living area. This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home has been recently renovated and offers over 4,500 sq. ft. of living space. The lower-level legal bonus area can be used as a children's playroom, an additional family room, or a bedroom/living room combo. The spacious backyard is ideal for creating lasting memories and is ready for a new family. With street entrances on every level and stunning views from each floor, this home truly provides a sanctuary of relaxation. Just a short walk away is Jack McLaren Park, the third-largest park in San Francisco. The park offers year-round events at the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater, multiple hiking trails, a bike park, a nine-hole golf course, a playground, picnic areas next to McNab Lake, a 10,000-square-foot pool, tennis courts, a ropes course, a dog play area, and a community garden, ensuring family fun all year long! Proximity to freeways and public transportation is perfect for commuters. Don't miss this opportunity to own a home that can accommodate the whole family.
